title.value: HiFormer: Hierarchical Multi-scale Representations Using Transformers for Medical Image Segmentation
title.justification: The extraction outlines the development of HiFormer, a hybrid CNN-transformer model for medical image segmentation.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose HiFormer, a novel method that efficiently bridges a CNN and a transformer for medical image segmentation.

extractions.description: The paper introduces HiFormer, a novel method combining CNNs and transformers for enhanced medical image segmentation. It highlights the limitations of current CNNs in modeling long-range dependencies and the challenges of transformers in capturing low-level features. HiFormer integrates a Swin Transformer module with a CNN-based encoder, using a Double-Level Fusion (DLF) module for feature fusion. Extensive experiments exhibit HiFormer's superiority over traditional methods in medical image datasets, addressing computational complexity and consistency in feature representations.
